cli.serve_readiness.unproven: recorded, but process identity cannot be proven (no start-time stamp could be compared)
cli.serve_readiness.not_this_daemon: recorded, but PID reuse was detected
cli.serve_readiness.install_unknown: runs a build the install cannot be compared with
cli.serve_readiness.cgroup_unknown: runs in a cgroup this check cannot place
cli.serve_readiness.recorded_gap: the record says build {recorded}; {install} is installed
cli.serve_readiness.unknown: {count, plural, one {the `lop serve` daemon on {device} — {reasons}, so whether it is current and supervised is not known} other {the `lop serve` daemons on {device} — {reasons}, so whether they are current and supervised is not known}}
cli.serve_readiness.stale: {count, plural, one {the `lop serve` daemon on {device} ({pids}) runs {builds} but the install is {install}: the remote sessions it hosts run that other build} other {the `lop serve` daemons on {device} ({pids}) run {builds} but the install is {install}: the remote sessions they host run those other builds}}
cli.serve_readiness.other_unit: {count, plural, one {the `lop serve` daemon on {device} is held by another service ({holders}), not a lop serve unit} other {the `lop serve` daemons on {device} are held by other services ({holders}), not a lop serve unit}}
cli.serve_readiness.identity_restart: on {device}, run `lop services restart` to move the recorded daemon onto the installed build; restart checks each daemon before acting
cli.serve_readiness.identity_no_action: {count, plural, one {the unproven record matches the installed build; no action is needed for this non-required check} other {the unproven records match the installed build; no action is needed for this non-required check}}
cli.serve_readiness.identity_restart_man: on {device}, restart `lop serve` by hand to move the recorded daemon onto the installed build; it cannot reload itself in place
